result.instructions: Tools for TheBusinessApp, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which jobs are scheduled for tomorrow, and who is assigned to each one?"; "Show me all invoices that are still drafts and their totals."; "Create a draft quote for the Patel account with two boiler service lines.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TheBusinessApp data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run thebusinessapp_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run thebusinessapp_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run thebusinessapp_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. thebusinessapp_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_create_enquiry
tools.title: Create an enquiry
tools.description: Add a new enquiry (lead) to the pipeline. Its source is set to api. TheBusinessApp API: POST /enquiries.

name.description: Name of the person who enquired.

service.description: Service asked about, e.g. Boiler service.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key so a repeated create does not make a second record (sent as Idempotency-Key).

tools.name: thebusinessapp_create_quote
tools.title: Create a draft quote
tools.description: Create a DRAFT quote for a customer. Totals are worked out for you. The quote is not sent; it stays in the app for a person to check and send. TheBusinessApp API: POST /quotes.

customer_id.description: Customer id the quote is for.

unit_price.description: Unit price in the company currency.

unit.description: Unit label, e.g. each, hour (default each).

product_id.description: Product id from thebusinessapp_list_products, if the line uses one.

job_id.description: Job id to link the quote to.

enquiry_id.description: Enquiry id to link the quote to.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key so a repeated create does not make a second record (sent as Idempotency-Key).
